description: T-103: TRACK, SNEAK and HIDE with their syntax lines, refusals and attempts, the FEEDBACK and DISARM TRAP refusals, and TAME and IDENTITY, which 1.11p never implemented. Needs the developer code on both sides: on the original CODEC_OF_TWINKS=78 in wccmmud.ini (STAGE_CODEC_OF_TWINKS or docker -e CODEC_OF_TWINKS) and the BBS key WCCSYSOP on the sysop account (mbbsemu_key.py; TWEAK, SUMMON, EXPRESS_TRAIN, MONSTER), on silvermere the DEBUG grant (`silvermere account grant sysop DEBUG`); and the BBS sysop account sysop/sysop with its character Sysadm on both (docs/testing.md, M4).
